MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

2. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 9
   C. 6
   D. 3

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 3
   C. 13
   D. 40

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 22
   C. 88
   D. 19

8. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 0

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 30

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

13. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

17. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 11
   D. 5

18. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

19. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

20. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

21. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

22. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 17
   D. 8

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

24. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

25. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 10

26. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

27. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

28. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 1
   D. 7

29. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 24

30. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
